origin.description: Map each string to upper case with ICU.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale, or one locale id such as tr_TR.

origin.details: Vectorized over str. Upper case can expand one code point into several, as with German eszett. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
origin.example:
x <- stri_trans_toupper("i", "tr_TR")
cat(paste0('stri_trans_toupper("i", "tr_TR") returns U+', sprintf("%04X", utf8ToInt(x)), '.\n'))

translation.description: Map each string to upper case with ICU.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale, or one locale id such as tr_TR.

translation.details: ICU UnicodeString.toUpper does the mapping. Turkish tr_TR maps i to dotted I (U+0130) and dotless i to I. German eszett expands to SS. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_toupper
x = stri_trans_toupper("i", "tr_TR")
print(f'stri_trans_toupper("i", "tr_TR") returns U+{ord(x):04X}.')
